controls.space: Press Space to throw a bomb.

map.title: Map
map.legend: Hard blocks are indestructible. Soft blocks are destructible and randomly placed. Corners are player spawn zones.

basics.title: Basics
basics.start: Every player starts with 1 bomb, 1 speed, and 1 life.
basics.bomb: A placed bomb explodes after 2–3 seconds, then you get your bomb back.
basics.block: Bombs can't be moved or walked through once placed.

power_ups.title: Power-ups
power_ups.bomb_plus: Bomb+ — place more bombs at once
power_ups.kick: Kick — kick bombs to slide them until they hit something

gathering.title: Collection and Use of Data
gathering.content: When you create an account and use Bomberman, we collect certain personal information such as your email address and password. This information is used to manage your account and improve your gaming experience. We do not share your personal information with third parties without your consent, except when required by law.

info_use.title: Use of Information
info_use.content: The collected information is used to manage your account, personalize your gaming experience, and provide you with updates about the game. We may also use your information to send you important communications regarding your account or the game.

storage.title: Data Storage
storage.content: Your personal information is stored securely and is only accessible to authorized members of the development team. We take measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, disclosure, or destruction.

third_party.title: Sharing of Information
third_party.content: We do not share your personal information with third parties, except when required by law or if you give us your explicit consent. We may share aggregated and anonymized information for analytical and game improvement purposes.

cookies_local_storage.title: Cookies and Local Storage
cookies_local_storage.content: Bomberman may use cookies and local storage to improve your gaming experience. Cookies are small files stored on your device that help us remember your preferences and track your progress in the game. You can manage your cookie preferences in your browser settings.

security.title: Data Security
security.content: We take the security of your personal information very seriously. We use standard security protocols to protect your data against unauthorized access, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. You can also object to the collection and use of your personal data. To exercise these rights, please contact us via the email address provided in the application or on our website.

project_nature.title: Educational Project
project_nature.content: Bomberman is an educational project developed within the context of a school project. As such, there may be temporary interruptions, maintenance or bugs. We strive to provide a stable and secure gaming experience, but we cannot guarantee continuous availability.

acceptance.title: Acceptance
acceptance.content: By creating an account and using Bomberman, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with these terms, please do not use the application.

account.title: Account Creation and Management
account.content: You are responsible for the confidentiality of your account and password. You agree to provide accurate information during registration and to keep this information up to date.

fairplay.title: Fair Play
fairplay.content: Players agree not to cheat, exploit bugs, harass other users or intentionally disrupt the game experience. Failure to respect these rules may result in account restrictions.

availability.title: Availability of Service
availability.content: This project is provided "as is". As an educational project, temporary interruptions, maintenance or bugs may occur.

intellectual_property.title: Intellectual Property
intellectual_property.content: All intellectual property rights related to Bomberman, including the source code, graphics and design elements, are the property of their respective owners. You agree not to copy, reproduce or distribute these elements without authorization.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.content: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. Please refer to our Privacy Policy for more details on how we collect, use and protect your data.

changes.title: Modifications of the Terms
changes.content: We reserve the right to modify these Terms of Service at any time. The modifications will be posted on this page and will take effect immediately after their posting. Please review this page regularly to stay informed about updates.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: If you have any questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us at the email address provided in the application or on our website.
